intro.paragraph: ArcGIS Urban is an immersive 3D experience designed to improve urban planning and decision-making. Quickly visualize projects in your local context and leverage location intelligence to drive better decisions. Be more proactive and less reactive in your planning process. Simplify project collaboration across internal agencies and public stakeholders.

centerVisual.title: Shaping future cities
centerVisual.desc: ArcGIS Urban is an immersive 3D experience designed to drive smart urban planning and development.

darkStrip.title: Improve planning productivity
darkStrip.desc: Streamline workflows and improve efficiency by focusing effort where it matters most.

darkStrip.title: Visualize projects citywide
darkStrip.desc: Visualize plans and projects in an immersive 3D view to understand change at the city scale.

darkStrip.title: Communicate trends
darkStrip.desc: Reveal insights about policies and initiatives to evaluate performance and support decisions.

darkStrip.title: Increase community engagement
darkStrip.desc: Bring transparency to planning programs by sharing interactive content with the community.

features.title: 3D city model as context for change
features.desc: Design a 3D representation of the city and gain contextual information to assess performance and support decision-making.

features.title: Zoning and land-use planning
features.desc: Produce 3D visual and analytical representations of your legal zoning code and measure the immediate impact of your proposed design.

features.title: Urban design and project sharing
features.desc: Quickly create detailed planning scenarios and share your work with stakeholders.

caseStudy.title: Urban Planning Excellence
caseStudy.desc: Discover how cities worldwide are leveraging ArcGIS Urban to transform their planning processes and drive smart development decisions.
